question: What supreme reverence do the sky-clad show toward the goddess?
premises: The goddess is borne on the head by the sky-clad.
The goddess is taken as refuge by the sky-clad.
These acts signify highest honor and reliance.
inference: The sky-clad honor the goddess supremely and take refuge in her.
plain_english: She is borne on the heads of the sky-clad and taken as their refuge.
